basic_info.title: Scaling Laws for Pre-training Agents and World Models

method.notes: Confirms LM-style power laws (loss vs optimal model size etc.) DO arise in world modeling and imitation learning, BUT the coefficients are heavily influenced by tokenizer, task, and architecture — uniform LLM rules of thumb mis-size agentic models. Key implication used in run2_capacity_diagnosis_and_scaling_review.md: sizing decisions for the decoder-light WM must come from a measured LOCAL scaling probe (P1/P2), not borrowed constants.

gap_analysis.whats_missing: Embodied robotics/video-game domains, not GPS map matching; methodology reference only.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Closest published bridge between LLM scaling laws and world-model training; justifies running local probes instead of trusting Chinchilla constants.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Indirect: methodological basis for P1-P3 probe design.

uncertain: Abstract-level verification only (2026-07-11 WebFetch); per-domain coefficient tables not independently checked.
